name: table_generate
label: 生成表格/流程图
description: Turn structured data (array of arrays or array of objects) into a Markdown table, optionally with a mermaid flow or pie chart, for the frontend to render; at most 10 rows per page and page 1 by default - never page through everything automatically; when there are more pages, just state the total count, the rest is reachable through the frontend pager, and pass page only when the user explicitly asks for more.

rows.description: array of arrays or array of objects (object keys become the header)

page.description: page number, at most 10 rows per page; page 1 by default, pass this only when the user explicitly asks for more
